text: The gate's runs end, even when no one waits for them. A Gobra run has a limit, 20 minutes, and one that doesn't finish fails with a clear message, so an agent simplifies its contracts instead of waiting; the gate had none, and one looped for most of an hour on part 2 of #177. And invariant mcp stops the call it's in once its client has gone, which it knows when its parent process is the system's first: a Codex run stopped at its time limit left its server behind, holding a Gobra container. Its containers are removed as a cancelled run's always are.
